snapshot.title: TNPSC General Awareness: Schemes & Awards
snapshot.exam_hook: ⚡ TNPSC GS Hook: Puthumai Penn: 1000. Makkalai Thedi: Health. 44th Chess: Mahabs. Innuyir: Accident. Thagaisal: High Honor.

quick_notes.title: State Awards
quick_notes.detail: 1. Thagaisal Thamizhar (Highest state honor). 2. Avvaiyar Award (Women excellence). 3. Kalaimamani (Arts/Culture). 4. Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Award.
quick_notes.explanation: The State Awards are honors given by the government of Tamil Nadu to recognize people for their achievements. The highest state honor is called Thagaisal Thamizhar, which means 'Respected Tamilian' and is awarded for exceptional service to the state. The Avvaiyar Award is given to women who have shown excellence and achievement in their fields. The Kalaimamani award, meaning 'Jewel of the Arts', recognizes contributions to arts and culture. The Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Award is named after the former President of India and honors individuals for their work in science, education, and humanitarian efforts.

quick_notes.title: Educational Schemes
quick_notes.detail: Naan Mudhalvan (Skilling). Puthumai Penn (Monthly ₹1000 for girls in higher ed). Illam Thedi Kalvi.
quick_notes.explanation: Naan Mudhalvan is a Tamil Nadu government scheme that provides skill training to students in schools and colleges to help them get jobs. Puthumai Penn is a scheme that gives a monthly payment of 1000 rupees to girls from poor families who are studying in higher education, like college or university. Illam Thedi Kalvi is a program where volunteers go to students' homes to teach children who have fallen behind in their studies, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic. These three schemes are part of the state's educational initiatives to support learning,

quick_notes.title: Health & Social Welfare
quick_notes.detail: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam (Healthcare at doorstep). Innuyir Kaappom (Road accident victims). Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme.
quick_notes.explanation: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam is a Tamil Nadu government scheme that brings healthcare to people's homes, meaning a team of doctors and nurses visits neighborhoods to check the health of residents, especially those who cannot travel to a hospital. Innuyir Kaappom is a program that provides free emergency medical treatment to people injured in road accidents, ensuring they receive immediate care without worrying about cost. The Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme gives a free, nutritious breakfast every morning to primary school students in government schools across Tamil Nadu to improve their health and learning.

quick_notes.title: Infrastructure
quick_notes.detail: Chennai Metro Rail Phase 2. TIDEL Park expansions. Fintech City (Chennai).
quick_notes.explanation: Infrastructure refers to the basic physical systems and facilities that a city or region needs to function, like transportation, communication, and power. The Chennai Metro Rail Phase 2 is a major expansion of the city's underground and elevated train network, which will add new routes to connect more parts of Chennai and help people travel faster. TIDEL Park expansions mean that the existing information technology (IT) parks in Chennai, called TIDEL Parks, are being made bigger by adding new buildings and office space, so more technology companies can set up their offices there. A Fintech City is a special area or district built specifically for financial technology companies, which are businesses that use technology to provide financial services like online banking, digital payments, and insurance. The Fintech City planned for Chennai will be a dedicated zone where these companies can work together, share resources, and grow, creating many jobs and boosting the local economy.

quick_notes.title: Sports
quick_notes.explanation: The 44th Chess Olympiad is a major international chess competition that was held in Mahabalipuram, a town in Tamil Nadu, in the year 2022. The Chief Minister's Trophy is an award given by the Tamil Nadu state government to recognize and honor the top performers or winners from this event.
